_help: AutoStack Quick Class. One entry per class, keyed by classId. To add a class: copy the income-tracker entry, give it a new key, fill it in, set status to ready, run npm run build. status: draft = built only in the draft preview (npm run dev -- --drafts). ready = live, and needs youtubeVideoId and ctaUrl. ctaUrl can be a full URL or site:<key> from config/site.json. Offer text can use {price_now} and {guarantee_days} from config/starter-kit.json, so the price is only typed in one place.

faq.question: Do I have to buy the kit to use what you showed?
faq.answer: No. You can build it yourself from the class. The kit saves you the setup time, and you get help when you get stuck.

faq.question: I am not technical. Can I still do this?
faq.answer: Yes. 35 of the 36 setups need no code, and every step is written out so you can follow along.

faq.question: What if it will not connect?
faq.answer: Bring your screen to AutoStack Live on the weekend, or ask in the community. If we still cannot get it working, the guarantee gives you your money back.

faq.question: How do I get it after paying?
faq.answer: Selar emails you the link to the kit and your community invite right after payment.

faq.question: Is this class really free?
faq.answer: Yes. You put in your name and email, then you watch.

faq.question: I am not technical at all. Can I really do this?
faq.answer: Yes. Zero coding. If you can copy and paste, you can do this.

faq.question: Is it safe? Do I have to give AI my bank password or BVN?
faq.answer: No. Nobody needs your bank password, PIN, OTP or BVN, and I will never ask for them. The tracker only reads the alert emails your bank already sends you.

faq.question: Do I have to buy anything at the end?
faq.answer: No. At the end of the class, I show you the AutoStack Starter Kit in case you want the full done-with-you setup. If you do not want it, you can close the video right there and keep everything you learned.

faq.question: What if I cannot watch it right now?
faq.answer: When you register, the watch link is sent straight to your email, so you never lose the page. Open it whenever you have time.

why.heading: You should not have to sit up at midnight typing transfers into a notebook.
paragraphs: If you run a business in Nigeria, you know the stress. Transfers come in all day. You pay dispatch riders, suppliers, data, and restocking fees from the same account. When month-end arrives, you feel busy, you feel broke, and you have no clear number for what you actually kept.

My first degree was History and International Studies. Today, I work as a software engineer. I have [organised a workshop](https://www.tonative.org/indaba-2026#:~:text=LinkedIn-,Chinenye%20Anikwenze,-Engineering%20Lead%2C%20Tonative) at the Deep Learning Indaba, and the ACM [featured my work on responsible AI](https://women.acm.org/u-rise-chinenye-anikwenze-from-an-academic-in-history-to-an-unconventional-advocate-for-responsible-and-inclusive-ai/).

I mention my History degree for one reason. I know how confusing technical tools look from the outside. When I built this bank-alert system, I stripped out every complicated step so any business owner who can copy and paste can set it up.
